content: We need to place CO2 onto slab at specified adsorption site with height ~2.0 Å. The site JSON contains coordinates: [0.9686491203251171, 1.1547005383792521, 23.98070938208362]. Those look like Cartesian coordinates? Possibly fractional? Values >1 suggest Cartesian in Å. We'll use add_adsorbate_to_slab_text tool. Need slab_cif string and adsorbate_cif string. Read CO2 cif.
